description: The routed write smoke on Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL2 with Docker Engine inside the distro (moved from the retired wsl2-smoke workflow, #1300): WS1 records and requires a real WSL2 kernel, WS2 installs Docker Engine and the Linux tools, WS3 builds and installs the candidate CLI, WS4 runs scripts/wsl2-smoke.sh, WS5 collects diagnostics, WS6 runs the one-command demo flow and confirms that every service it started answers and that flisk down stops the stack. Manual runs only; Docker Desktop integration is not tested.
